run_slurm_pipeline: run a SlurmPipelineExecutor to download and process a Hugging Face dataset on a Slurm cluster
create_jsonl_reader: create a JsonlReader that reads JSON files from a Hugging Face dataset with language metadata
create_jsonl_writer: create a JsonlWriter that writes processed data to compressed JSONL files grouped by rank
build_data_pipeline: build a data pipeline using JsonlReader and JsonlWriter to transform a Hugging Face dataset into local JSONL files
test_slurm_executor: test the SlurmPipelineExecutor configuration with 100 tasks, 1 GB memory per CPU, and a 12-hour time limit
